messages:
maria: Heads-up — EU hourly aggregate backfill is failing on slice around 2026-03-20T02Z. Operator logs showing quota_rejects + KV warmup timeouts. Seeing stalls and retries. Anyone else?
aj: I see it too. Replayer telemetry shows heavy pressure on tenant bucket 'acme-eu-prod'. Console currently assigned those jobs to default-priority lane which gets preempted.
kevin: default-priority gets shoved aside by higher-priority replays. Two quick options: route these recomputes to an opportunistic pool or split slices smaller to avoid quota spikes.
maria: Can we flip a per-tenant routing override? There's a console flag (recompute.priority_bracket) but it requires a small rollout.
tara: DevEx ran a preflight earlier — paste of the dry-run:
```
preflight: slices 120 -> est tokens 3.1B
kv_miss_rate: 0.12
est_cost_increase: 14%
```
tara: that kv_miss_rate is the main pain. If we warm KV before the main run it helps a lot.
ben: 12% miss isn't catastrophic but will push QPS. Warmup + throttled main run seems safest.
aj: The quota governor will likely block a bursty warmup unless we mark it exempt or bump quota temporarily.
ops-bot: Reminder: quota bump requests should go through /ops/quota and need ~4h lead time for manual approvals. :robot_face: 
kevin: If ops bump isn't possible, fractional reslice is promising — break each slice into micro-slices by tenant prefix and run across opportunistic pool. Lowers peak concurrency.
maria: How mature is fractional reslice? DevEx, is it enabled?
tara: API supports it but priority routing to opportunistic is behind a feature-flag per-org. We can flip for a short canary window. Example kick command (preflight):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://platform/recompute" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{
  "tenant": "acme-eu-prod",
  "slice_policy": "fractional",
  "fraction_size": 8,
  "priority": "opportunistic",
  "preflight": true
}'
```
aj: Note: the API currently rejects priority:"opportunistic" unless the feature-flag is set in org config.
kevin: I can flip the feature-flag for acme-eu-staging for a 10m window as a canary, then for prod if everything looks good.
maria: Sounds good. Proposed plan:
 - kevin: flip feature-flag and kick fractional preflight on staging (T+30m)
 - tara: run a small KV warmup job for the hottest prefixes (T+35m)
 - aj: monitor recompute/quota metrics and be ready to escalate if quota_rejects spike
 - ben: add short-lived dashboard tile: recompute.kv_miss_rate / recompute.quota_rejects for acme-eu-prod and staging
kevin: I'll post logs and the flip confirmation in this thread.
ben: I'll add the tile and an alert: warn if quota_rejects > 5 within 10m.
maria: Prefer we start after 40m to avoid EU peak traffic.
aj: +1, 40m works for me. :thumbsup:
kevin: Can do. Will flip at T+30m on staging and report back. If staging preflight looks stable we go prod with fractional + warmup later tonight.
maria: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me directly. We'll close the loop in ~2h with a short postmortem note.
-- end of thread
